items.headline: Council to get updates on dam, flood and water reuse projects
items.summary: The October 13 agenda lists a joint update on El Niño preparedness for the 2026-2027 rainy season, including the Anderson Dam seismic retrofit, Coyote Creek flood protection work, and the Pure Water Silicon Valley potable reuse project.

items.headline: Peery Park plan may add office space, housing
items.summary: The October 12 Planning Commission agenda listed a study session on a proposed Peery Park Specific Plan amendment to increase office/R&D space and residential units, allow relocation of the Libby Water Tower, and receive public comments on a supplemental environmental review.

items.headline: Second round of City Attorney candidate interviews set
items.summary: The October 9 agenda also listed a closed session for City Attorney candidate interviews, a day before another round scheduled on October 10.

items.headline: Equinix data center build-out permitted on Great Oaks Boulevard
items.summary: A tenant-improvement building permit for an Equinix data center was issued at 123 Great Oaks Boulevard, with a declared permit valuation of about $48.4 million.

items.headline: Commission reviews all-electric construction zoning rules
items.summary: The Environmental Planning Commission's October 7 agenda included amendments to Mountain View's zoning program requiring all-electric construction.

items.headline: R3 and R4 zoning changes up for commission recommendation
items.summary: The Environmental Planning Commission's October 7 agenda listed a recommendation on adopting amendments to R3 and R4 multi-family zoning districts, along with related precise plan and general plan changes.

items.headline: City weighs dissolving regional radio communications authority
items.summary: The October 6 City Council agenda included dissolving the Bay Area Regional Interoperable Communications Systems Authority, along with an amendment to San José's agreement with Santa Clara County for access to the county's criminal justice information system.

items.headline: Trimble B apartment project and parking garage permitted
items.summary: A new apartment building reporting 372 dwelling units, plus a separate parking garage, received building permits at 120 Yoshino Way, with a combined declared permit valuation of about $94.3 million.
